```sql
ORDER BY excellence_rate DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH admin_names AS (

    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname2") <> ''
    UNION ALL

),
name_counts AS (

    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 2
)

FROM name_counts nc
JOIN admin_names an ON an."first_name" = nc."first_name"
GROUP BY nc."first_name", nc.cnt, an."district"
ORDER BY nc.cnt DESC, nc."first_name", an."district";
```

```sql
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
      AND l.status = 'A'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),

    LIMIT 1

    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN target_client tc ON tc.client_id = d.client_id
),
/* Баланс на 1993-03-22 (ближайшая транзакция до/на эту дату) */

    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_accounts ca ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= DATE '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    ((ba.balance - bb.balance)::numeric / bb.balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM bal_a ba
CROSS JOIN bal_b bb;
```

```sql
SELECT
    c."name" AS card_name,
    l."status" AS legality_status
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l
    ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."types" = 'Artifact'
  AND c."side" IS NULL
  AND l."format" = 'vintage'
ORDER BY c."name";
```

SQL запрос:

raw_response:
```sql
/* Вычисляем процент карт Story Spotlight без текстового блока и выводим их ID */
WITH spotlight AS (
    SELECT
        "id",
        "istextless"
    FROM "cards"
    WHERE "isstoryspotlight" = 1
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "istextless" = 0) AS no_text_count
    FROM spotlight
)
SELECT
    s."id",
    /* Процент карт Story Spotlight без текстового блока */
    (t.no_text_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM spotlight s
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE s."istextless" = 0
ORDER BY s."id";
```

```sql
    (SUM(CASE WHEN c."hasnonfoil" = 1 AND c."hasfoil" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric

FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd
    ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese'
```

```sql
/* Вычисляем потребление (consumption) по сегментам за 2012 и 2013 годы для клиентов с валютой EUR */
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment" AS segment,
        LEFT(ym."date", 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND LEFT(ym."date", 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", LEFT(ym."date", 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        consumption_2012,
        consumption_2013,
        (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) AS increase_abs,
        /* Процент увеличения = (Increase / consumption 2013) * 100 */
        CASE
            WHEN consumption_2013 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2013) * 100
        END AS pct_increase
    FROM pivoted
)

    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    increase_abs,
    pct_increase
FROM calc
WHERE pct_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    increase_abs,
    pct_increase
FROM calc
WHERE pct_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_increase ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
